title: E-Document DE: map Payment Method to PEPPOL payment means codes, add SEPA Direct Debit export support
summary: Payment methods can now be mapped to standard PEPPOL payment means codes, enabling SEPA Direct Debit support in German E-Document formats with automatic fallback to SEPA credit transfer for compatibility.
key_points: New PEPPOL Payment Means Code field on Payment Method table lets admins assign EN 16931 codes to each payment method
ZUGFeRD and XRechnung exports use mapped codes and include payee/payer IBAN, BIC, and mandate details for SEPA direct debit
Fallback to code 58 (SEPA credit transfer) when no code is assigned preserves existing behavior
New XML Document Validator codeunit validates XRechnung and ZUGFeRD output against official UBL and CII schemas
Events allow third-party apps to handle additional payment means requiring custom XML nodes
